summary: This is a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by Public Service Enterprise Group Inc. for a public offering of $ % Senior Notes due 2031. There is no specified dollar amount or coupon rate in the excerpt. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing senior unsecured debt and mature June 2031. They are redeemable under optional redemption or upon a Tax Credit Event at 101% of principal. Proceeds before expenses go to PSEG. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No special situation attributes such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign are present.
